module.name: test-assertions
module.description: Resolves supported expect and assert calls through imports and unshadowed globals.

scenarios.name: should resolve Jest Vitest and Chai expect calls
scenarios.given: expect is an unshadowed global, supported named import, Vitest test-context parameter, Chai namespace member, or Vitest soft poll or element member

scenarios.name: should resolve Chai Sinon and Vitest assert methods
scenarios.given: assert is a supported named import or Chai or Sinon namespace member

scenarios.name: should resolve Node assert calls and methods
scenarios.given: Node assert is imported as a default, namespace, or named strict binding from a built-in assert module
scenarios.when: isSupportedAssertCall resolves a direct call or method call

scenarios.name: should ignore unrelated and shadowed bindings
scenarios.given: expect or assert is shadowed or imported from an unrelated package

scenarios.name: should ignore unrelated member chains
scenarios.given: a call uses an object unrelated to a supported assertion import
